verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own CLI can list gallery models (`local-ai models list`) and pull and run models directly from Hugging Face or Ollama URIs (`local-ai run huggingface://...`, `ollama://...`). That covers browsing and downloading from the command line. Search and management actions are not documented: there is no search or filter command, and no evidence of install-only, delete, or update operations from the CLI. Missing for 10: CLI search/filter command, CLI model removal/update/management commands, dedicated CLI install command docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
